The paper repurposes a subset of Newsroom into a multi-domain dataset called MULTI-SUM.

This re-purposed subset of Newsroom is named MULTI-SUM to indicate it is specially designed for multi-domain learning in summarization tasks [4], and it serves as a multi-domain testbed with IN-DOMAIN and OUT-OF-DOMAIN settings [6][8].

The paper repurposes a subset of Newsroom into a multi-domain dataset called MULTI-SUM.
